llm_judge_details.justification: The topology covers the three main slices (eMBB, URLLC, mMTC) required for the smart city use cases, but omits several optional core VNFs (e.g., PCF, NEF) and any edge or analytics functions for traffic management, reducing completeness. VNF types and interconnections follow 3GPP TS 23.501 conventions, so correctness is good. Resource requests are far too low for a city‑scale deployment and do not match the high throughput SLA, leading to poor resource appropriateness. Slice definitions align well with the described scenarios, earning full marks. The SLA (20 ms latency, 10 Gbps throughput, 99.999% availability) is ambitious given the modest resources, making the SLA fit only partially.
